policy_cases.name: descriptive_evidence
policy_cases.required_text: When source evidence is descriptive, factual statements must remain descriptive.

policy_cases.name: strongly_actionable_evidence
policy_cases.required_text: Add analyst interpretation only when it follows without introducing a new factual premise.

policy_cases.name: insufficient_evidence
policy_cases.required_text: If evidence does not support a distinct implication or action, remain descriptive or omit it.

policy_cases.name: recommendation_vs_factual_claim
policy_cases.required_text: Classify source-derived factual statements as factual and MarketLense-authored recommendations as recommendation; never present a recommendation as a source claim.
